car.name: Bistort 1986
car.description: A burgundy wedge coupe restored for 2994, with a glass hatch, eager naturally aspirated engine and light front-wheel-drive five-speed chassis.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: Late 1986 continental European launch Volvo 480 ES, 1721cc naturally aspirated 10.5:1 engine, 80kW ECE, FWD five-speed manual, LHD, standard 185/60HR14 alloy wheels, solid roof. Original Volvo E10829-01 Paris introduction press pack. Not Turbo, later catalyst B18F/EP, 2.0, automatic, US prototype or convertible. Non-catalyst launch interpretation; no catalyst output mixed in.

sources.access: Original Volvo 1986 press release E10829-01; full PDF saved, technical specification and dimension drawing pages16-17 rendered and visually read. Primary table specifies 998kg, not secondary1016kg; 80kW5800rpm and140Nm4000rpm ECE; ratios3.091/1.842/1.320/.967/.758,reverse3.545,final4.067;21.3steering,185/60HR14. Drawing4258x1710x1318mm,WB2502.7mm,1410tracks. Standard alloy wheels, optional sunroof omitted.

estimates: Engine code B18E and non-catalyst selection interpret the 80kW/10.5:1 launch configuration; the original table gives specification but no engine code. No later catalyst or Turbo ratings substituted.

48litre tank is a provisional period estimate pending direct tank-capacity documentation. 61percent front mass, CG, ground clearance, overhang split, Cd.34,850idle/6200redline/6500limit, torque interpolation,30psi, shift behavior and suspension/grip are explicit simulation estimates. 118mph approximates published greater-than190km/h;9.2sec0-60 estimates9.5sec0-100.

Conventional simulation approximates MacPherson front and beam rear geometry. Shared wheel/wipers and live digital instruments are a2994 reinterpretation; optional factory electronic information functions and popup animation are not simulated. Auto Assist is fictional; production selection is5MT. Original badge-free art retains closed headlamp lids.
